QR code images embedded in phishing emails that resolve to Sway-hosted login pages
Inclusion of Cloudflare Turnstile scripts (challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js) on Sway-hosted pages
network_indicators: Outbound connections to sway.cloud.microsoft with suspicious or atypical URL paths
HTTP POST requests to domains such as login.msofficeopt.nl, gdu.msofficeopt.nl, ffnthost365.cfd, nedttis365.xyz, msntntion0.cfd
Loading of Cloudflare Turnstile API from Sway-hosted pages mimicking Microsoft login
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor inbound emails for QR codes that resolve to sway.cloud.microsoft URLs, especially those leading to login forms. Flag Sway-hosted pages that contain login forms with action attributes pointing to non-Microsoft domains or that load Cloudflare Turnstile scripts. Detect HTTP POST requests from endpoints to known phishing domains. Alert when a user is immediately redirected to a legitimate Microsoft service after submitting credentials on a non-Microsoft domain. Correlate these behaviors to identify and block phishing campaigns abusing Microsoft Sway.
